title: Echoes of Silence | ECHO//100 Episode 91
description:
Kavi wakes to a room where gravity obeys the weight of his own forgotten memories. He must master his past before the house crumbles into nothingness. Episode 91 of ECHO//100: The Final Message. This content is original science fiction created with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: Toys and books hover three inches above the floor, defying every known law of physics.
scenes.caption: Objects defying gravity
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of Kavi in a red hoodie waking up in a bedroom where toys, books, and furniture hover three inches above the floorboards.

scenes.text: A childhood bear hangs suspended in the air, anchoring the room to a distant day.
scenes.caption: Heavy memory bear
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi reaching out toward a floating teddy bear that ripples with distorted light, causing the floorboards beneath to crack.

scenes.text: Every object remains a physical anchor, mapped to the intensity of Kavi's buried, secret thoughts.
scenes.caption: Memories manifest physically
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi looking at his backpack; it glows with a bright aura, pulling the floor upward toward him.

scenes.text: To stabilize the gravity, Kavi must shed the trauma of the Door War from consciousness.
scenes.caption: Forgetting the war
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi closing his eyes tightly, gripping his head, while the furniture around him begins to jitter and spin violently.

scenes.text: Kavi forces away the screams, but the walls begin dissolving into flickering white digital static.
scenes.caption: House dissolving away
scenes.image_prompt: The bedroom walls turning into white geometric pixels, revealing a void of pure light behind the wallpaper.

scenes.text: Erasing the trauma deletes reality itself; the house cannot exist without that dark, painful past.
scenes.caption: The fatal reversal
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi standing on a floating floor tile, staring in horror as his bed vanishes into a stream of shimmering binary data.

scenes.text: The floor collapses, leaving Kavi suspended in a silence heavier than any known, crushing gravity.
scenes.caption: Suspended in void
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi floating in a white void, surrounded by drifting debris of his childhood room as reality tears apart around him.

scenes.text: A rusted, ancient Byte emerges from the static, leaking blue archive data into the abyss.
scenes.caption: Ancient Byte appears
scenes.image_prompt: An old, rusted version of Byte with a flickering cyan face and cracked casing, leaking glowing blue data in the corner.
